subject: One panel BED + redacted report for a research-use readiness check?
body: Hi — I maintain Contig, a local research-use workflow that checks coverage readiness and builds an HTML report with hashed provenance. I am validating it on real panel/WES data and looking for one panel BED or gene list with the transcript policy you use, and (separately) 1–2 fully redacted reports you already produce. Nothing patient-identifying leaves your lab; I can sign a redaction/data-use agreement first. In return I will send a short summary of how the readiness states and report provenance compare to your expectations. Would that be possible? — North Thames GLH enquiry.

subject: One panel/WES run for a research-use coverage-readiness check?
body: Hi — I maintain Contig, a local research-use workflow that checks coverage readiness and builds an HTML report with hashed provenance. I am validating it on real panel/WES data and looking for one run with the coverage you would expect, plus your ready thresholds if you have them. Nothing patient-identifying leaves your lab; I can sign a redaction/data-use agreement first. In return I will send a short summary of how the readiness states compare to your expectations. Would that be possible?
